title: LEGO® Discovery Center Atlanta Admission Ticket
includes: Admission to Lego Discovery Center Atlanta
Food and drinks (available for purchase) (not included)
requirements: Infants and small children can ride in a pram or stroller
All areas and surfaces are wheelchair accessible
Suitable for all physical fitness levels
Please note: LEGO Discovery Center is a children's attraction; to promote a safe and family-friendly environment, adults cannot enter without being accompanied by a child.
cancellation: For a full refund, cancel at least 24 hours before the scheduled departure time.
blurb: Discover the exciting world of LEGO® at the LEGO Discovery Center, featuring MINILAND’s incredible miniature LEGO builds that captivate visitors of all ages. Participate in hands-on workshops and hone your building skills in the interactive Build Adventures area designed for endless creativity. Enjoy thrilling LEGO-themed rides and immersive 4D movie experiences, all included with your admission ticket. Perfect for families and LEGO fans, this indoor attraction offers a fun-filled day of play, learning, and adventure.
